input.quote: b. paying the applicable early termination charges, if any, specified in Attachment A and applicable Service Option Attachments.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no express liquidated damages or penalty clause, but Section 3.4(b) makes Customer pay "early termination charges" on convenience termination in an amount defined only by an open cross-reference to Attachment A and the Service Option Attachments (neither of which caps the amount, and Attachment A is not part of this document). That is a Customer-payable termination amount with no ceiling, so it fails the fallback position of an early-termination fee capped at three months' fees; unbounded, it could approach or exceed remaining contract value (walk-away territory). Because a termination charge is a normal part of the bargain in a facilities-services deal with a broad convenience-termination right, we took the fallback rather than deleting the charge: the redline caps aggregate early termination charges at three (3) months' recurring Charges for the terminated Services and makes them Customer's sole liability for the termination. Section 3.5's accrued-payment obligation is ordinary and not flagged, and Section 3.3's carve-out (no early termination charges where IBM breached) already runs in our favour.

proposal.summary: Cap early termination charges payable by Customer at three months' recurring Charges
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Our playbook does not accept liquidated amounts payable by us, so we have capped the early termination charges cross-referenced to Attachment A at three months' recurring Charges and made them the sole amount due on convenience termination. We are happy to keep the charge itself, but it needs a defined ceiling rather than an open cross-reference.

ops.newText: b. paying the applicable early termination charges, if any, specified in Attachment A and applicable Service Option Attachments; provided that Customer's aggregate early termination charges for any such termination will not exceed three (3) months' recurring Charges for the terminated Services and will be Customer's sole liability arising from such termination.
